headline: As of 2026-10-05: 1,351,048 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 31 of 50 states, D+31.6 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,351,048 early/mail ballots cast so far across 31 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+31.6 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (349,576), Florida (204,866), New Jersey (178,984).
